title: DSL-authored Runtime View
description: Deliver a Datadog-grade visual Runtime workspace derived entirely from human/AI-authored ArchMap DSL. No OpenTelemetry or vendor connector is required.
completion_criteria: The parser and canonical model retain DSL-authored runtime services, dependencies, metrics, events, time windows, health, and provenance.
Runtime View provides query controls, canvas, inspector, timeline, minimap, health rings, metric edge encoding, selection, filtering, and deterministic grouping.
Design, Runtime, and Diff modes preserve measured, estimated, declared, unknown, and no-data semantics without implying a live connector.
JSON, CSV, SVG, and PNG exports work, and node selection is keyboard accessible.
100/1000/10000 element projection, browser visual behavior, docs, tests, QIF, and AOF handoff are verified.
success_criteria: The runtime map is immediately legible at operational information density and large authored models can be grouped before rendering.
Users can pivot from observed behavior to authored architecture and lifecycle evidence without confusing observation with intent.
The product uses original ArchMap visual components and does not copy third-party branding, proprietary assets, or pixel-identical UI.
triage_notes: ArchMap remains DSL-first. Do not add OpenTelemetry, Datadog, or other connector dependencies. Runtime facts are authored snapshots with explicit provenance.
